_comment: Pins RFC-MACP-0006 Section 4.7 and RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.6 item 1 for a session-scoped Mode message: each Envelope's macp_version is validated on its own, with no reliance on Initialize, and a mismatch is reported in band in the Send Ack as UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION. A runtime that also replays the fixture set over the HTTP binding checks Section 4.4 with the same step: the rejection is an in-band Ack, not a request-level error. The rejected Vote records nothing, so the identical Vote at macp_version '1.0' is accepted next (RFC-MACP-0001 Section 8.3).
description: Transport: per-Envelope macp_version validation, reported in band.

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0006 Section 4.7: an unsupported macp_version on a session-scoped Vote, in a session opened at '1.0'.
The same Vote at the default macp_version '1.0'. Accepted: the rejection above recorded no vote for agent://a, which RFC-MACP-0007 Section 5 rule 3 would otherwise reject as a second vote.
